name: Git
description: Repository state for buttons: branch, ahead/behind, and staged/unstaged/untracked counts as structured fields rather than porcelain a face would have to parse, plus commit, push, pull, fetch, branch switching and stashing. The point is resource://git/status/{repo} — a live, subscribable status that pushes when you save a file, commit or switch branches, so a key can show "main ↑1 ~3" without polling. Watching only runs while something is bound. No force-push, reset, rebase or amend: use the bash pack if you mean it.
summary: Live repo status as a subscribable resource, plus commit, push, pull and stash.

default_repo.description: Absolute path to the repository buttons should act on when they don't name one. Lets a face be authored without hard-coding a path.

auto_fetch_seconds.description: How often to `git fetch` in the background while a face is bound, so ahead/behind stay true. Off by default (0) — a silent fetch on someone's repo should be asked for. 300 is a reasonable value.

poll_seconds.description: How often to re-read `git status` while a face is bound, which is how working-tree edits are noticed (commits and branch switches are instant via a file watcher). Default 4.
